description: (Na)₂LiScCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiScCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiScCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ScCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-Cl bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Sc atom.
